name: Banned | 200mg Deep Sleep Gummies | Watermelon
description:
The Benefits of a 1:1 CBN to THC Combination

A 1:1 ratio of CBN (Cannabinol) and THC (Tetrahydrocannabinol) offers a unique balance of effects, making it an excellent choice for those seeking relaxation, pain relief, and a smoother cannabis experience.

What Makes This Combination Special?

Deep Relaxation & Sleep Support – CBN is known for its sedative properties, making it ideal for winding down at the end of the day. When paired with THC, it can help promote restful sleep without overwhelming psychoactivity.

Pain & Inflammation Relief – Both CBN and THC have analgesic properties, meaning they work together to reduce pain, inflammation, and discomfort. This makes it a great option for those dealing with chronic pain conditions.

A Calmer, Milder High – THC can sometimes cause anxiety or overthinking, but CBN helps balance those experiences, providing a more mellow, clear-headed effect.

Enhanced Appetite Stimulation – If you're struggling with appetite loss, the combined effects of CBN and THC may help stimulate hunger more effectively.
